ModMetaData.name: PUAH 1.5 Queue Hotfix V5.2.1
ModMetaData.author: Local hotfix
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.5 Pick Up And Haul hotfix. V5.2.1 preserves the proven V5.1 queue-repair/reservation-guard DLL unchanged and adds a separate fail-safe performance DLL that accelerates PUAH's private FindClosestThing multi-haul search with an exact 16x16 spatial index. JobOnThing is not transpiled; original PUAH sorting, reachability, validator, storage, reservation and queue semantics remain authoritative.
RimWorld 1.5 Pick Up And Haul 修复补丁 V5.2.1：原封不动保留已验证的 V5.1 队列修复/Reservation 防崩 DLL，并额外加载独立性能 DLL，仅用 16x16 精确空间索引优化 PUAH 私有的 FindClosestThing 多目标搬运搜索。V5.2.1 不再 Transpile JobOnThing，PUAH 原本的排序、可达性、Validator、仓储、Reservation 与队列语义保持不变。
